title: A Noise Tolerant SQP Algorithm for Inequality Constrained Optimization
summary: We propose a sequential quadratic programming (SQP) algorithm for inequality constrained optimization that is robust to the presence of bounded noise in function and derivative evaluations. We cover the case where constraint evaluations contain noise as well as the objective. The proposed algorithm is a line search SQP method with relaxations to deal with noise. We study the effect of noise on the global convergence behavior of the algorithm.
